modes.name: Amulet's Abeyance
modes.duration: until the start of your next turn
modes.note: Adept Benefit (Amulet): when you use Amulet's Abeyance, you or your ally chooses one damage type dealt by the triggering attack and gains resistance 5 against it (10 at 15th level). Set the type you chose; if the ally took it instead, leave this off.

modes.name: Arbor Wine
modes.note: You have tremorsense at a range of 30 feet. Aged wine also makes vegetation around you writhe into difficult terrain until the start of your next turn — that is battlefield-side, not on your sheet.

modes.name: Arbor Wine
modes.note: For 1 minute after drinking a glass, you have tremorsense at a range of 30 feet.

modes.name: Misty Chill
modes.duration: until the beginning of your next turn
modes.note: Misty Chill: you Raise the Shield and gain resistance 5 to cold. Any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes 3d6 cold damage (basic save) — that damage lands on their sheet, not yours.

modes.name: Blood Booster
modes.note: Resistance 5 to persistent bleed and persistent poison damage. You also lower the DC of any flat check to end persistent bleed or persistent poison damage as if you had received particularly appropriate aid (DC 10).

modes.name: Bloodhound Mask
modes.note: Imprecise scent with a 15-foot range. When you use Survival to Track a creature by its scent, your proficiency bonus is equal to your level even if untrained. You can't wear another mask while wearing it.

modifiers.appliesWhen: to Track a creature by its scent

modes.name: Bloodhound Mask
modes.note: Imprecise scent with a 30-foot range. When you use Survival to Track a creature by its scent, your proficiency bonus is equal to your level even if untrained. You can't wear another mask while wearing it.

modifiers.appliesWhen: to Track a creature by its scent

modes.name: Bloodhound Mask
modes.note: Imprecise scent with a 60-foot range. When you use Survival to Track a creature by its scent, your proficiency bonus is equal to your level even if untrained. You can't wear another mask while wearing it.

modifiers.appliesWhen: to Track a creature by its scent

modes.name: Olfactory Stimulators
modes.note: Activate (once per day): your stimulators twitch and gather more information, giving you imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

modes.name: Break the Sun's Legs
modes.note: The stolen light is channeled to your eyes, granting you greater darkvision. The surrounding area is under a 9th-rank Darkness effect for the same minute — that part is on the battlefield, not your sheet.

modes.name: Jellyfish Oil
modes.note: Resistance 5 to precision damage and to the extra damage from critical hits. You also ignore difficult terrain from tight spaces that don't force you to Squeeze, move 5 feet per round when you succeed at Squeeze (10 feet on a critical success), and can Crawl at half your Speed.

modes.name: Clockwork Goggles
modes.note: The lenses cycle rapidly, granting you low-light vision.

modes.name: Clockwork Goggles
modes.note: The lenses cycle rapidly, granting you low-light vision and darkvision.

modes.name: Clockwork Goggles
modes.note: Low-light vision, darkvision, and the effects of See the Unseen — invisible creatures are concealed to you rather than undetected.

modes.name: Close Formation
modes.duration: while wielding two fans, one in each hand
modes.note: Fan-dance spatial awareness: while you wield two fans, each in a different hand, you gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 20 feet.

modes.name: Creeping Ashes 1
modes.note: Cursebound 1: weakness 2 to fire damage. Any immunity or resistance you have to fire is suppressed.

modes.name: Creeping Ashes 2
modes.note: Cursebound 2 (cumulative): weakness 2 to fire with any fire immunity or resistance suppressed, plus swirling ash imposing a −2 circumstance penalty to your ranged attack rolls.

modes.name: Creeping Ashes 3
modes.note: Cursebound 3 (cumulative): your weakness to fire is 5 + your level and any fire immunity or resistance is suppressed; the −2 circumstance penalty to ranged attack rolls continues.

modes.name: Creeping Ashes 4
modes.note: Cursebound 4 (cumulative): fire weakness 5 + your level, −2 circumstance to ranged attack rolls, and a −10-foot status penalty to all your Speeds as your limbs crumble — apply that Speed penalty by hand, the mode can't.

modes.name: Headwinds 1
modes.note: Cursebound 1: electricity weakness 2. Electricity spells and effects with extra effects against a creature wearing or holding metal treat you as wearing metal, and any immunity or resistance you have to them is suppressed.

modes.name: Headwinds 2
modes.note: Cursebound 2 (cumulative): electricity weakness 2 and you count as wearing metal for electricity effects, plus blowing winds imposing a −2 circumstance penalty to your ranged attack rolls.

modes.name: Headwinds 3
modes.note: Cursebound 3 (cumulative): your weakness to electricity is 5 + your level, you still count as wearing metal for electricity effects, and the −2 circumstance penalty to ranged attack rolls continues.

modes.name: Headwinds 4
modes.note: Cursebound 4 (cumulative): electricity weakness 5 + your level, −2 circumstance to ranged attack rolls, and the raging winds push you back for a −10-foot status penalty to all your Speeds — apply that Speed penalty by hand, the mode can't.

modes.name: Inevitable Rot 1
modes.note: Cursebound 1: you gain weakness 2 to acid and poison damage.

modes.name: Inevitable Rot 2
modes.note: Cursebound 2 (cumulative): weakness 2 to acid and poison, and a −1 status penalty to saves against diseases and poisons. Anyone attempting to Treat your Disease, Poison, or Wounds also takes −1 — that penalty is on their sheet.

modes.name: Inevitable Rot 3
modes.note: Cursebound 3 (cumulative): your weakness to acid and poison damage increases to twice your level; the −1 status penalty to saves against diseases and poisons continues (and −1 for anyone treating you).

modes.name: Inevitable Rot 4
modes.note: Cursebound 4 (cumulative): acid and poison weakness twice your level, and the status penalty to saves against diseases and poisons increases to −2 (as does the penalty for anyone attempting to Treat your Disease, Poison, or Wounds).
